DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出来事の場所を図にされたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You drew a diagram of where the incident happened, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、私が立っていた向きを上に描きました。上が北だと受け取られると、車の向きが違ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見取図の上を自分の視点にしたため北と誤解させたくないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I drew it with the direction I was facing at the top. If the top is taken to be north, the car's direction will be wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you used your own viewpoint for the top of the sketch and do not want it mistaken for north. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の向きと、ご自身がいた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please explain the orientation of the diagram and where you were.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この点が私で、向かいの店を上にしました。地図の方角を確認して描いた物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分と店を示し地理の方角を確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This dot is me, and I put the shop opposite at the top. I did not check compass directions on a map before drawing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out yourself and the shop, and explain that you did not check the geographical directions. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車が進んだ向きは、どちらでしたか。今の図で分かる範囲を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which way was the car going? Please indicate what you can establish from this diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店の前から私の右側へ進みました。矢印を上へ描きましたが、道の形に合わせて直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車は店前から自己の右へ進み矢印の訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It went from in front of the shop toward my right. I drew the arrow upward, but I would like to correct it to match the shape of the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the car went from the shop front toward your right and ask to correct the arrow. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正前の説明も分かるようにして、担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the person in charge, keeping the original explanation clear as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。最初の矢印を黙って消し、最初から正しかったことにはしません。私の立つ場所と車の進路を分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 黙って消さず旧矢印と立ち位置と進路を区別して話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not quietly erase the first arrow and make it appear correct from the start. I will explain my position and the car's route separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not silently erase it and will distinguish the old arrow, your position, and the route. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際の位置関係は、担当と照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us compare the actual positions with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。図の上を北と断定せず、目印と立ち位置で説明します。図にない場所を見たとも言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 方角を断定せず目印と自己が見た範囲で位置関係を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will explain using landmarks and where I stood, without stating that the top is north. I will not claim to have seen places outside the diagram either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the positions using landmarks and the area you actually saw, without asserting compass directions. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図の向きも含めてお話を伺います。それでは、こちらで担当とご確認ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hear your account, including the diagram's orientation. Please check with the person in charge here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その箱は、贈り物としてお送りになるものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending that box as a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。リボンで持てるように結びました。これを持ち手として、運んでもらえると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈答箱のリボンを運送用持手にできると思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I tied the ribbon so it could be carried. I thought they could use it as a handle to transport the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the ribbon on the gift box could serve as a carrying handle for shipping. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 装飾のリボンと、荷物を運ぶ持ち手は別です。箱と包装の状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: A decorative ribbon and a handle for carrying a parcel are different. Let us check the box and its wrapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: リボンは見た目を整えるための物でした。今も、手では箱の底を支えて持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 装飾目的で実際は箱底を支えて運んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The ribbon was for making it look nice. Even now, I brought it here supporting the bottom of the box with my hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the ribbon was decorative and you actually carried the box by supporting its bottom. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外に出た飾りも含めて、発送できる状態か担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consult the person in charge about whether it is ready for shipping, including the decorations sticking out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。引っ張って強さを試すのでなく、リボンが外へ出ている状態を見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引張って試さず外に出る飾りの発送状態を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Instead of pulling it to test its strength, I will have them look at the ribbon sticking out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consult about the shipping condition of the protruding decoration without pulling it to test it. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱の外の飾りを、相手の方に残したいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like the recipient to keep the decoration outside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残したいですが、発送のために必要なら飾りを別に入れる方法も考えます。見た目だけを優先して送り方を決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飾り保存希望だが必要なら別封入などを検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would, but if shipping requires it, I will also consider packing the decoration separately inside. I will not decide how to send it based on appearance alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to preserve the decoration but will consider packing it separately inside if necessary. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身と、外側の包装のご希望を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge what is inside and how you would like the outside wrapped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 中身は衣類です。衣類を送る箱と贈答用の飾りを分けて説明し、発送時の包み方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 衣類の発送と装飾希望を分け外装方法を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It contains clothing. I will explain the box for sending the clothing separately from the gift decoration, and check how it should be wrapped for shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish shipping the clothing from your decoration preferences and check the outer wrapping. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認しました。それでは、リボンを持ち手にせず箱をそのままお出しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed your wishes. Please present the box as it is without using the ribbon as a handle. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳のどの表示が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which entry in your bankbook concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この行に知らない名前があります。私の口座の名前が変わったのかと思い、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明細行の未知名を口座名義変更と思い相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an unfamiliar name on this line. I wondered whether the name on my account had changed, and would like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an unfamiliar name in a transaction entry that you thought meant a change of account holder. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳の名義と、取引の説明の欄を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the account holder's name separately from the transaction description field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表の私の名前はそのままです。この取引の行の文字だけ見て、口座全体が別人名義になったと考えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義欄は本人名で取引行を口座全体へ広げた誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name on the front is unchanged. Looking only at the text on this transaction line, I mistakenly thought the whole account was now in someone else's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding: the name field is yours, but you extended the transaction entry to the whole account. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取引内容については、ご本人の情報を確認して担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will verify your identity details and explain the transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。相手の名前らしいと分かっても、この取引を私が認めたことにせず、覚えのある取引か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手名らしくても取引承認ではなく心当りを確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Even if it seems to be the other party's name, that does not mean I have acknowledged this transaction. I want to check whether I recognize it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that identifying what appears to be the other party's name is not approval of the transaction and you want to check whether you recognize it. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時や金額を、ご自身の記録と照らし合わせられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you compare the date, time, and amount with your own records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この日の振込控えはあります。文字の見た目だけで別人の取引と決めず、控えと合わせて見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の控えがあり見た目で他人取引と決めず照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the transfer receipt from that day. I will not decide it is someone else's transaction just from the lettering; I will have it checked against the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have that day's receipt and request a comparison without judging from appearances that the transaction belongs to someone else. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認ができるまで、通帳の文字をご自身で消したり直したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until it is checked, please do not erase or alter the text in your bankbook yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのまま出します。名義の確認と、明細の一件の内容確認を分けてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳を改変せず名義と一件の取引内容を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will present it unchanged. Please check the account holder's name separately from the details of this one statement entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request separate checks of the account holder and this transaction without altering the bankbook. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの確認点を担当へ伝えます。それでは、控えも一緒にご用意ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass both points to the person in charge. Please have the receipt ready too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物の食品をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for food to give as a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。冷凍のお菓子を見ています。友達へ渡せば家で保管してもらえると思いましたが、冷凍庫があるか聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍贈答品を選ぶが相手宅の冷凍庫は未確認と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am looking at frozen sweets. I thought my friend could store them at home after I handed them over, but I have not asked whether they have a freezer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are choosing a frozen gift but have not checked whether the recipient has a freezer at home. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の保管条件と、お渡しになる予定をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the product's storage requirements and your handover plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日の外出先で渡すつもりです。帰宅まで持ち歩く友達に、すぐ冷凍できると決めて選べませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明日外出先で渡し帰宅まで携帯するので即冷凍できるとせず説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to give it to my friend while we are out tomorrow. They will carry it until they get home, so I cannot choose it assuming they can freeze it immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will hand it over while out tomorrow and your friend will carry it until returning home, so immediate freezing cannot be assumed. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取る方の保管方法も、先にご相談なさってはいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Why not discuss storage with the recipient beforehand as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。相手へ渡す時間だけでなく、その後いつ帰るかも聞きます。今はこの品を決めずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受渡し後の帰宅時刻も尋ね今の品の決定を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I will ask not only when to hand it over but also when they will get home afterward. I will hold off deciding on this item for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask when they return home after receiving it and postpone choosing this item. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の条件の商品をお探しの場合も、表示を個別にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you look for products with different requirements, please check each label individually too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。常温の売場にある物なら何でも同じと思わず、候補ごとに保存方法を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別売場でも候補ごとの保存表示を個別に読むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will check the storage instructions for each candidate, rather than assuming everything in the room-temperature section is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will read each candidate's storage label individually, even in another section. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量や、お召し上がりになる予定も考えてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also consider the quantity and when it will be eaten.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さな贈り物でよいので、相手が扱える条件を先に確認します。冷凍品を見たから、それを必ず買う約束にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 少量でよく受取人の保管条件確認前に購入約束はしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: A small gift is fine, so I will first check what conditions the recipient can manage. Looking at a frozen item does not mean I have promised to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say a small amount is fine and you will not commit to buying before checking the recipient's storage conditions. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相手のご都合が分かりましたらご相談ください。それでは、ご条件に合う候補をお選びください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult us once you know the recipient's circumstances. Choose a candidate that meets your conditions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 黄色いブロックの上で遊ぶご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to play on the yellow blocks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが順に跳びたいと言っています。模様があるので、遊びの目印だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黄色ブロックを子どもの跳び遊びの目印と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child says they want to jump along them in order. Since they have patterns, I thought they were markers for playing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the yellow blocks were markers for your child's jumping game. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは歩く方の案内のための点字ブロックです。遊びで道を塞がず、別の場所へお移りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are tactile paving blocks to guide pedestrians. Please move elsewhere without blocking the path by playing on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ跳ばせていません。ブロックのある道を進む方のために、子どもと脇へ寄ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ遊ばせず親子で案内用通路から脇へ寄ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not let my child jump on them yet. I will move aside with my child for people following the path with the blocks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not let the child play and will both step aside from the guidance path. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持っている荷物も、その上へ置かないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not put your belongings on them either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋を通路の外で持ちます。今は誰も来ていないから使ってよい、と考えるのも違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物も外で持ち現時点に人がいなくても使用根拠にしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will hold the bag outside the path. It would also be wrong to think we can use it because nobody is coming right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will keep your luggage off the path and will not treat the current absence of people as permission to use it. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 遊ぶ場所は、園内の案内と利用状況を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: For a place to play, please check the park information and current usage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。線のような表示を見ても全部を遊び道具と思わず、何のための物か先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示の用途を先に確認して別の遊び場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. Even if markings look like lines, I do not want to assume they are all play equipment; I want to ask what they are for first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the purpose of the markings first and ask about another place to play. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お子様にも、通る方を案内する道だとお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain to your child too that this path guides people passing through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。遊ぶ目印は別の場所で考えます。点字ブロックを使う人が来てから退くのでなく、最初から道を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用者が来てからでなく初めから案内道を空けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will think of game markers somewhere else. We will keep the path clear from the outset, rather than moving only when someone who uses tactile paving comes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the guidance path clear from the beginning, without waiting for a user to arrive. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、案内用の道を空けて公園をご利用ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy the park while keeping the guidance path clear. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お見送りでしょうか。ご乗車になる方はどなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you seeing someone off? Who will be boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達が乗ります。久しぶりなので話が止まらず、切符を渡すのも後にしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗るのは友人で再会会話中に切符返却を後回しにしたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is. We had not met for a long time and could not stop talking, so I had put off handing back the ticket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your friend is boarding and you postponed returning the ticket while catching up. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず乗る方が準備できるよう、持ち物をお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please hand over their belongings so the traveler can get ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私のかばんに預かった切符を返します。見送る私が持っていても、友達の準備が済むわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分鞄の券を本人へ返し見送り所持を準備完了としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will return the ticket I was keeping in my bag. My holding it as the person seeing them off does not mean my friend is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will return the ticket from your bag to its owner and will not equate your holding it with readiness. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発車の案内も、ご本人と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the departure announcements with your friend too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認します。写真をもう一枚撮ることより、友達が落ち着いて乗れる時間を優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加撮影より本人が落着いて乗る時間を優先すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I will prioritize giving my friend time to board calmly over taking one more photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will prioritize time for your friend to board calmly over another photo. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人は、今どのようにされたいとお話しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: What does your friend say they would like to do now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に移動したいそうです。寂しいから待ってと繰り返すのでなく、続きの話は後で連絡しようと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の先移動希望を受け別れ惜しさで引止めず後連絡と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say they want to move on first. Instead of repeatedly saying to wait because I am sad to part, I will suggest continuing our conversation by contacting each other later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Respect your friend's wish to move on, avoid holding them back because parting is hard, and suggest talking later. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通る方の妨げにならない所でお見送りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please see them off from somewhere that does not obstruct others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 脇へ移ります。私も乗るように急いで付いて行かず、友達だけが乗る予定を確認して見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路外で本人のみ乗車と確認しつられて乗らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move aside. I will not hurry along after them as if I were boarding too; I will confirm that only my friend is traveling and see them off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will stay out of the passage, confirm only your friend is boarding, and avoid following them aboard. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備ができましたら案内に沿ってお進みください。それでは、ご友人のよい旅をお見送りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once ready, please follow the guidance. Please see your friend off on a pleasant journey. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会議の記録について、確認したい点があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have something to check about the meeting minutes, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の名前の下に、言っていない提案が書かれています。席札の位置が途中で変わったので、発言者が混ざったのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 議事録で未発言提案が本人名下にあり席札変更との関係を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A proposal I did not make is written under my name. The name cards were moved during the meeting, so the speakers may have been mixed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a proposal you did not make recorded under your name and its possible connection to the moved name cards. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記録と、ご自身が覚えている発言を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will hear what the record says separately from the statements you remember making.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は開始時刻について質問しました。施設の名前を変える提案はしていません。ただ、誰が言ったかまでは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は開始時刻質問のみで改称提案なしだが他発言者は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked about the starting time. I did not propose changing the facility's name. However, I do not remember who said that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you only asked about the starting time and did not propose renaming, but do not know who did. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ、確認したい記載を示してお伝えいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can show the person in charge the entry you want checked and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私の発言ではないという点は伝えますが、近くにいた人の名前を推測で書き足すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分発言でない点のみ訂正を求め他人名を推測で加えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I will say that it was not my statement, but will not guess and add the name of someone who was sitting nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request correction only of its attribution to you, without guessing and adding someone else's name. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その記録は、もう他の方へ共有しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already shared that record with anyone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友達一人に送りました。自分の名前で提案が確定したと受け取られないよう、その部分は確認中と知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共有した友人へ該当提案は確認中と知らせ確定意志としないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sent it to one friend. I will let them know that part is being checked, so they do not take it as a confirmed proposal from me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the friend you shared it with that the proposal is being checked, rather than presenting it as your settled intention. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で公開版を消して差し替えず、訂正の方法も担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the person in charge how to correct it, rather than deleting and replacing the public version yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。元の記録と私の質問を示します。席が変わったという事情はありますが、それが原因と断定せず確認を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元記録と本人質問を提示し公開版を自己差替えせず原因確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show the original record and my question. The seats did change, but I will request a check without stating that this caused the error.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the original record and your question, request a check of the cause, and do not replace the public version yourself. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認したい箇所を担当へお伝えください。それでは、記録をそのままお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the person in charge the part you want checked. Bring the record unchanged. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明をお待ちの間に、ご心配なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything worrying you while you wait for the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先生が紙を見て黙っていたので、悪い結果なのかと思いました。でも、結果の説明はまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 医師の沈黙を悪い結果と推測したが未説明と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The doctor was silent while looking at a paper, so I wondered if the result was bad. But I have not heard the explanation of the results yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you inferred a bad result from the doctor's silence, but have not received an explanation. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 沈黙から結果を決めず、ご不安な点を診療担当へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us tell the clinical team what worries you, without deciding the result from the silence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。私が見たのは紙を読む様子だけです。何が書かれているかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察したのは紙読みに限り記載内容は未知と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. All I saw was the doctor reading the paper. I did not see what was written on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you only observed the paper being read and do not know its contents. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの点を先に確認したいか、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a preference about what you would like checked first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 結果が説明される順序と、質問できる時を知りたいです。今ここで病名を当ててほしいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 病名推測でなく説明順と質問時間の確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know the order in which the results will be explained and when I can ask questions. I am not asking you to guess a diagnosis here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the explanation order and time for questions, rather than speculation about a diagnosis. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当へ伝えます。ご家族へは連絡されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request to the team. Have you contacted your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。悪い結果だったと先に送るのではなく、説明を待っている状態だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ悪結果確定ではなく説明待ちと連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. Instead of first sending that the results were bad, I will tell them I am waiting for the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your family you are awaiting an explanation, without presenting a bad result as confirmed. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明の後も、分からない言葉は聞き直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the explanation too, please ask again about any words you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。緊張していることも話します。聞いた結果と、自分が沈黙から想像したことを分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 緊張を話し実説明と沈黙からの想像を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will also say that I am nervous. I will distinguish the results I actually hear from what I imagined from the silence when checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are nervous and will distinguish the actual explanation from your interpretation of the silence. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 説明と質問のご希望を担当へお伝えします。それでは、案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the team your wishes about the explanation and questions. Please wait for guidance. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 動画の資料をお持ちですね。手を加えた部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have video material with you. Have you altered any part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 暗くて見づらかったので、明るさを変えました。車の番号らしい数字が見えますが、元では読めませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗い動画を明るくし後から数字らしい表示が見えたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was dark and hard to see, so I changed the brightness. I can see what look like digits of the car's number, but I could not read them in the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brightened a dark video and only afterward saw something resembling digits. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の動画と加工した物を、分けて確認します。元は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will examine the original video and the edited version separately. Have you kept the original?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。加工した方だけが本物の記録だと説明せず、同じ動画から作った物だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元を保持し加工版を唯一の原記録と説明しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I will not describe only the edited version as the authentic record; I will explain that it was made from the same video.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you retained the original and will not describe the edited version as the sole original record. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身がその場で見たことも、別にお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also explain separately what you saw at the scene yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車が通ったことは見ました。番号をその時に覚えたのではなく、後で画面を見て考えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現場で見た車と後から考えた番号を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw the car pass. I did not memorize the number then; I considered it later while looking at the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the car you saw at the scene from the number you inferred afterward. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めない所は、推測のまま確かな数字として埋めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Where something is unreadable, please do not fill in guesses as definite digits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友達が三だと言いましたが、私は五にも見えます。どちらかに決めて書き込むことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の三と自己の五の不一致を確定数字に書込まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My friend said it was three, but it also looks like five to me. I will not choose one and write it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not enter a definite digit when your friend's three differs from your five. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方の資料と、変更した内容を担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the person in charge both materials and tell them what you changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明るさを変えたと説明します。切り取っていない元も見せ、現場の記憶、画面、友達の意見を分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 加工内容と原動画を示し記憶画面他者意見を分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I changed the brightness. I will also show the uncropped original and distinguish my memory of the scene, the screen, and my friend's opinion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the original video and explain the edits, distinguishing memory, screen content, and another person's opinion. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料の違いを伺いました。それでは、元の動画を残したまま担当とご確認ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have heard how the materials differ. Please check with the person in charge while keeping the original video. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお手紙について、確認したい点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have anything to check about this letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙に香りを付けました。私には好きな香りですが、相手も好きだとは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自己好みの香りを紙へ付けたが受取人好みは未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I added a scent to the paper. I like the scent, but I have not asked whether the recipient likes it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you scented the paper according to your own preference but have not checked the recipient's preference. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何を、どのように付けたか教えてください。発送の取扱いも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what you applied and how. We will also check the shipping arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し香料を吹き付けました。瓶そのものは入っていません。紙は乾いて見えますが、それだけで送れるとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 吹付香料のみで瓶は未同封かつ乾燥外観を可否根拠としないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I sprayed on a little fragrance. The bottle itself is not enclosed. The paper looks dry, but I have not concluded from that alone that it can be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only sprayed fragrance is present, no bottle is enclosed, and a dry appearance does not establish shipping acceptability. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 準備の状態を担当へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consult the person in charge about its prepared condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。別の封筒で包めば相手にも香りがしなくなる、とも考えず、手紙を書き直す方法も検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外封筒で無臭化と決めず書直しも検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I will not assume another envelope will prevent the recipient from smelling it, and will also consider rewriting the letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume an outer envelope removes the scent and will consider rewriting. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ投函前でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you not posted it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。相手に香りが大丈夫か聞いてからにします。贈り物だから拒否できないような伝え方はしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未投函で本人へ確認し贈物を拒否不能にしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, not yet. I will ask the recipient whether the scent is all right first. I do not want to present it in a way that makes them unable to refuse because it is a gift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is not posted, you will check with the recipient, and you will not make the gift impossible to refuse. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身を変えた場合は、発送する状態でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you change the contents, please consult us with it in the condition you intend to send.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の好み、相手の希望、発送の条件を分けます。香りを足してよかったという自分の判断だけでは出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分好みと受取意志と発送条件を分け自己判断のみで送らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will distinguish my preference, the recipient's wishes, and shipping requirements. I will not send it solely on my own judgment that adding scent was a good idea.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish your taste, the recipient's wishes, and shipping conditions and will not send it based on your judgment alone. Convey this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の準備について担当へご案内します。それでは、未投函のままお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer you to the person in charge regarding its current preparation. Please bring it without posting it. Goodbye.
